abstract: McKinsey's 2023 survey finds that generative AI has reached a breakout moment, with one-third of organizations using gen AI regularly in at least one business function and overall AI adoption reported by 55% of survey respondents. The report examines the state of AI implementation across organizations and the accelerating adoption of generative AI technologies.
keyFindings: One-third of survey respondents report their organizations are using generative AI regularly in at least one business function
Overall AI adoption is reported by 55% of survey respondents
methodology: Survey-based study of organizational AI adoption rates. Specific sample size, respondent characteristics, survey period, and sampling methodology not specified in excerpt.
